nodes.name: List Live Client Opportunities
nodes.notes: UNVERIFIED: the filter query string syntax (stage[eq]:LiveClient) is a guess at Twenty CRM's REST filtering convention, not confirmed. Also assumes every Opportunity carries a liveClientSince timestamp and an engagementScore field (the latter written by W4.1's health/usage scoring, not built) - if engagementScore doesn't exist yet, this workflow has nothing real to filter on and will need adjusting once W4.1 exists.

nodes.name: Split Out
nodes.notes: UNVERIFIED: assumes the list response wraps records under a top-level 'data' array - same Twenty CRM REST-shape uncertainty as every workflow here, and the n8n Split Out node's own parameter name/shape for this n8n version isn't confirmed either.

nodes.name: Flag referral-eligible on Opportunity
nodes.notes: Auto-flags eligibility (internal, reversible) - per the automation risk boundary, actually ASKING the client for a referral is an external send and stays human-gated, which is why this workflow stops at flagging + alerting a rep, not drafting/sending anything itself.

nodes.name: Alert rep

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'info', source: 'referral-trigger', message: $json.companyName + ' is now referral-eligible (' + $json.tenureDays + ' days tenure, engagement ' + $json.engagementScore + ') - reach out to ask.' }) }}

nodes.notes: Calls the real alert-dispatcher workflow (phase-2-calendar-nurture-alerts/alert-dispatcher.workflow.json) by its webhook path, not a bare placeholder - this is the first workflow in this library built after that dispatcher existed, so it uses it directly instead of a standalone alert node.
